name: @blobatar/cli
description: Deterministic geometric blobatars from any string, in your terminal.
//engines: The published artifact runs under plain node — npx is where the non-JS-project audience lives — so src/ uses no Bun-only APIs. A deliberate, documented exception to the repo's Bun-first preference; bun and bunx work too.

scripts.check: bun test && bun run build && bun run smoke

//dependencies: Exactly these three at runtime. A real dependency rather than the adapters' peer range, because the audience runs `npx @blobatar/cli` and has nothing else installed — an unmet peer is a broken command, where for an adapter it is a bundler warning in a project that already has core. The range is core's exact version, written by `changeset version` on each release: lockstep means this bin was built and smoke-tested against that one, so that is the pairing it hands a caller rather than whatever the major resolves to that day. resvg-js ships per-platform napi prebuilds as optionalDependencies with no postinstall. blobatar-v1 aliases the frozen v1 major so --gen 1 renders it, the same pairing apps/api uses.
